name: LaBeau's Seedless Shake Hack (Fresh Banana, Chocolate Malt, or Vanilla Cheesecake)
brandOrRestaurant: LaBeau's / LaBeau's Too (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Lets you join the LaBeau's shake line without ingesting sharp raspberry seeds by choosing one of their smooth, seed-free flavors like Fresh Banana, Chocolate Malt, or Oreo/Cheesecake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small Fresh Banana, Chocolate Malt, or Vanilla shake (avoid berry flavors with seeds and nut flavors like Burnt Almond Fudge) and take 2 Lactaid caplets before sipping.
watchOuts: High lactose in ice cream base—always pair with Lactaid
Avoid Burnt Almond Fudge or Pecan flavors (whole nuts)
